He then prepares a bowl of yogurt, adding blueberries and sliced bananas. He eats the yogurt while focused on an off-screen monitor. (3) At night, the man is in a yard on a blue yoga mat. He sits at a dining table and eats with a spoon, expressing satisfaction and talking about the food's texture. (6) The video concludes with a simple graphic animation of two children standing on a yellow background.
